core_claims.name: renameExt / substExt / liftRenExt / liftSubExt
core_claims.scope: Pointwise equality of arbitrary maps suffices for equality of renamed/substituted terms in every scope; no function extensionality assumed.

core_claims.name: renameId / renameComp
core_claims.scope: Renaming identity and arbitrary renaming composition for all scoped terms.

core_claims.name: substRename / renameSubst
core_claims.scope: Both mixed renaming/substitution composition laws, including the lifting and weakening equations needed under binders.

core_claims.name: substId / substComp
core_claims.scope: Simultaneous substitution identity and arbitrary substitution composition for all scoped terms.

core_claims.name: cancelShift / unusedBinder
core_claims.scope: Substituting any argument for a freshly added unused slot after weakening returns the original arbitrary open term.

core_claims.name: renameBeta / substBeta
core_claims.scope: Renaming and simultaneous substitution commute with a beta body/argument substitution for arbitrary maps, bodies and arguments.

core_claims.name: cons / betaSubst
core_claims.scope: Substitute an environment beneath a binder, then supply an arbitrary target-scope argument: the result equals one substitution with the explicitly extended environment.

core_claims.name: renamingAsSubstitution
core_claims.scope: Every renaming is exactly substitution by the corresponding variable terms, proved from identity and mixed composition.

deviations: The upstream Part2 chapter is organized as this book's appendix and module PLFA.Appendix.Substitution.
Fin-scoped, pointwise map laws replace global function equalities, avoiding a function-extensionality axiom while retaining arbitrary-map substitution and beta interaction results.
